newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals market closed for holiday.

text.p: India's metals trade was on holiday on Thursday to celebrate a Hindu festival and will reopen on Friday, dealers said.

On Wednesday, base metals were steady on low industrial demand and narrow trade, they said. Nickel was steady at 39,500 rupees per quintal on stray physical support, after falling by 400 rupees on Tuesday.
Copper was unchanged at 12,300 rupees, so was zinc at 6,300 rupees and lead at 4,900 rupees, respectively. Aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees on nominal trade.
